ti.title: ሳምራዊ ሕይወተይ
ti.lyrics:
[[chorus]]
ኣብ ሕሱም ደልሃመት ብግፍዒ ወዲቐ
በይነይ እና’ቕባሕባሕኩ ረዳኢ ናፊቐ
ድሙቕ ብርሃን መስቀልካ ምስ ኣብርሀ ኣብ ልዕለይ
ፍጹም’የ ተለዊጠ ተዘኒኑ ኵሉ ቁስለይ
[[/chorus]]

ዋልታይ ክብረይ ኢኻ ሳምራዊ ሕይወተይ
ሓያል ተበጃዊ ኣምላኽ ረድኤተይ
ንዓኻ ከመስግን ሰቒለ ሕሊናይ
እንሆ ክልተ ኣእዳወይ ዘርጊሔ ናብ ሰማይ

ኤልሻዳይ ኣምላኽ በዓል ርህሩህ ልቢ
ከም ሕያዋይ ጓሳ ንነፍሰይ ክትናቢ
መዓስከ ተታኺስካ ሓለዋይ ምስ ነቓሕካ
እነሆ’ንዶ ቲ’ለውሃትካ የንብረኒ ኣብ ሕቝፍኻ

ልዕሊ ሞት ነጊሰ ሰዊደ ክብርትዕ
ድኹም ሓያል ኮይነ ብቓልካ ክረትዕ
ኵሉ ብስምካ ክሰግሮ ዓቐብን ገደልን
ምልክኻ የዕቲርካኒ ምልኪ ሰይጣን ንኸብንን

ti_ro.title: Samrawi hywetey
ti_ro.lyrics:
Waltay kbrey ikha samrawi hywetey
Hayal tebejawi amlakh redetey
Nakha kemesgn seqile hlinay
Nho klte adawey zergihe nab semay
Ab hsum delhamet bgfi wediqe
Beyney na’qbahbahku redai nafiqe
Dmuq brhan mesqelka ms abrha ab lley
Ftsum’ye telewite tezeninu kwilu qusley
Elshaday amlakh beal rhruh lbi
Kem hyaway gwasa nnefsey ktnabi
Measke tetakhiska haleway ms neqahka
Neho’ndo ti’lewhatka yenbreni ab hqwifkha
Nefsey ms rekhebet hywet ms terefa
Smka tray koynu mewtsi qal afa
Beqa tdset tzmr zeykem blzub weyni
Kemza fthti btey bhagoska tezlleni
Lli mot negise sewide kbrt
Dkhum hayal koyne bqalka kret
Kwilu bsmka ksegro aqebn gedeln
Mlkkha yetirkani mlki seytan nkhebnn
Nay senselet mequh tsorey kab teragf
Hlfi mot fqrkha lbey kab ztnkf
Selem aykebln ye akaley nkhzane
Knbrkekhelka’ye goytay bfqrkha teamine
